The '''Quarek'k''' was a large bar complex located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] shortly after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Literally meaning '''dive''' in the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] language, the Quarek'k was home to several smaller barrooms that catered to many different species. Located in the undercity of the city-planet; to enter, one walked through a portal on the street and dropped by [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] a story to a waiting [[Pedwalk|pedway]], all the while being scanned for weapons.

Among the barrooms were the [[Crimson Redrum]] and the [[Green Dystopia]]. [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] visited the dive when on the hunt for [[Jax Pavan]].

At some point afterward, the singer [[Javul Charn|Alai Jance]] came to the attention of the Black Sun [[Vigo/Legends|vigo]] and former [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Hityamun Kris]] while performing a song cycle in the Quarek'kk about [[Human/Legends|Human]] immigrants on the world [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], and the pair subsequently pursued a romantic relationship.<ref name="Shadow Games">''[[Shadow Games]]''</ref>
